en: Color postcard view of a European historic town square seen through a stone archway. The square is paved with cobblestones and busy with people, market stalls, and umbrellas. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with steep red-tiled roofs and ornate stepped and curved gables in a late Gothic / Renaissance style. The central yellow building has several decorative gabled dormers; adjacent grey and cream buildings show typical North/Central European historic town architecture. The clothing styles of the people suggest mid‑20th‑century (post‑war) Europe. There is a round road sign with a red border on the right side.
